title.purpose: The figure's H1, top-left of every chart page; 19px under 640px.

title-compact.purpose: The H1 in the map header strip.

body.purpose: The one-sentence description under the title, ink-2, capped at 72ch.

label.purpose: Legend keys, segmented options, tooltip body, table cells, SVG category labels, map cards and popups.

small.purpose: Axis ticks, value labels (600), source line, footer actions, tooltip sub-lines.

column-head.purpose: Uppercase table headers and legend-card section headings in ink-3.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: The only box shadow; surfaces floating over a map or a plot (tooltip, cards, popups, search list, logo markers).

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single easing for every state transition (120 to 150ms) and CSS transform.

motion.name: first-draw
motion.purpose: Marks grow in on first render only; skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Action link

components.css: .ds-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px; font-family: var(--rb-font, 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--rb-ink-3, #6f6f6f); font: inherit; font-size: 0.75rem; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.15em; text-decoration-color: transparent; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), text-decoration-color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-action:hover { color: var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-action[aria-pressed="true"] { color: var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); font-weight: 600; } .ds-action svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; fill: currentColor; }

components.css: .ds-legend { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--rb-font, 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-key { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 2px 4px 2px 0; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--rb-ink-2, #4a4a4a); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; line-height: 1.3; border-radius: 2px; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-key:hover { color: var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); } .ds-key:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-swatch { flex: none; width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--swatch); transition: opacity 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-key[aria-pressed="false"] { color: var(--rb-ink-3, #6f6f6f); text-decoration: line-through; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; } .ds-key[aria-pressed="false"] .ds-swatch { opacity: 0.25; } .ds-count { color: var(--rb-ink-3, #6f6f6f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; width: min(92vw, 300px); font-family: var(--rb-font, 'Source Sans 3', system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-search input { width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px 8px 34px; border: 1px solid var(--rb-hairline, rgba(27,27,27,0.14)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--rb-surface, #fff); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,27,27,0.08), 0 6px 16px rgba(27,27,27,0.10); font: inherit; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--rb-ink-3, #6f6f6f); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--rb-ink, #1b1b1b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-search > svg { position: absolute; left: 11px; top: 17px; width: 14px; height: 14px; transform: translateY(-50%); fill: var(--rb-ink-3, #6f6f6f); pointer-events: none; } .ds-search ul { margin: 4px 0 0; padding: 4px 0; list-style: none; background: var(--rb-surface, #fff); border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(27,27,27,0.08), 0 6px 16px rgba(27,27,27,0.10); } .ds-search li { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.8125rem; } .ds-search li:hover, .ds-search li[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--rb-hover, rgba(27,27,27,0.06)); } .ds-search .muted { color: var(--rb-ink-3, #6f6f6f); font-size: 0.75rem; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
Every Remoboko figure is a whole page that happens to be embedded in an iframe: a title, one sentence of description, the plot filling the remaining height, and a hairline-topped footer carrying the source line and three text-link actions. Nothing around the figure competes with it. There is no site header, no card frame, no toolbar, no decorative device; the chart reads the way a Datawrapper embed reads inside a newspaper article, and it is judged by that bar.

The material is white paper and near-black ink. Two greys carry everything subordinate (descriptions, axis labels, sources); colour is spent only on data, and only from two fixed sources: the pinned country trio and an eight-slot categorical palette that never generates hues. Density is editorial rather than dashboard: one figure per page, 22px title, 15px body, 12px axis type, 4px rhythm.

Maps follow the same doctrine with a header strip and a full-bleed MapLibre body; the only floating surfaces are the legend card and the search/basemap tools, and on phones the legend collapses to a single "Show key" link so the data keeps the frame.
keyCharacteristics: The figure is the page: 100dvh flex column, no chrome, embeds cleanly at any iframe height.
White ground, one workhorse sans (Source Sans 3), hairline grid, crisp-edged axes.
Near-black ink with exactly two greys; colour is reserved for data marks.
Legends are text keys with 12px swatches; controls are underlined text links and one segmented toggle.
Every value is reachable without hovering: labelled bars, tabular figures, and a "Show as table" view on every chart.
Depth is a single soft shadow used only for surfaces that float over a map or over the plot (tooltip, cards, popups).

rules.name: The Two Sources Rule
rules.body: Data colour comes from exactly two places: the country trio when the encoding is country, the categorical palette in rank order otherwise. Hues are never generated, interpolated toward another hue, or picked per page. (The treemap's lighter descendant tints are a lightness ramp toward white of an assigned palette colour, not a new hue.)

rules.name: The Seventh Fold Rule
rules.body: A multi-series chart names at most seven series; everything past that folds into one "Other" series in Other Grey and is enumerated in the footer note.

rules.name: The Grey Is Text Rule
rules.body: The three inks are for text and rules only. No data mark is drawn in ink-2 or ink-3; the only grey data mark is Other Grey.

rules.name: The Four Steps Rule
rules.body: Interface type uses only the four size tokens (22 / 15 / 13 / 12). Weight and ink, not extra sizes, carry emphasis: 700 for the title, 600 for values, table heads and tooltip titles, 400 elsewhere.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Any number that sits in a column, an axis, or a legend count is set with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The Float Rule
rules.body: A shadow is permitted only on a surface that overlaps a map or a plot. Anything in the page's flow (title, legend, controls, footer, table) is flat and hairline-ruled.

dos: Do build every new figure as the head / controls / plot / footer column with the source line in the footer and "Show as table", "Download PNG", "Download SVG" as text actions.
Do take colour from the country trio or the categorical palette in rank order, and fold the eighth-and-beyond series into Other Grey.
Do keep axis and source type at 12px / ink-3 and never lighter than ink-3 (5.3:1).
Do label values on the mark, keep the table view, and make every hit target row-wide or at least 42px tall on phones.
Do reserve the Float shadow for surfaces that overlap a map or a plot.
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion by skipping the first-draw animation, and embed Source Sans 3 into any exported SVG.
donts: Don't add site chrome, card frames around the plot, or a toolbar; the figure is the page.
Don't generate, interpolate, or hand-pick a new hue for a series; the palette order is fixed and validated.
Don't render a filled button; actions are underlined text links and the one segmented toggle.
Don't put a shadow on anything in the page flow, or a border on a legend key.
Don't use CARTO raster tiles or any keyed basemap; basemaps are OpenFreeMap Liberty / Positron / Dark via MapLibre.
Don't introduce a second typeface, a fifth interface size, or non-tabular numerals in a column.
